question: Which among the following is the oldest and biggest amongst all the four Vedas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rig Veda**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Rig Veda is the oldest and largest of the four Vedas:
 
• Rig Veda: The oldest and largest Veda, written in Sanskrit around 1500 BC.
 
• It is made up of 1,028 hymns, or sūktas, divided into 10 books, or maṇḍalas.
 
• The Rig Veda is considered the most important of the Vedas and is the basis for the other three. 
 
• The other three Vedas are the Sama Veda, Yajur Veda, and Atharva Veda.
 
• The word "Veda" comes from the root word "vid" which means "to know".
 
• Vedic literature is a valuable source of information about ancient India. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Samaveda
 
• A collection of hymns about religious rituals that were sung by priests during yajnas.
 
 
• The Samaveda is considered a primary source of Indian music and art.
 
 
 
• Yajur Veda
 
• A collection of hymns and rituals for yajnas, which is sometimes translated as "Knowledge of the Sacrifice".
 
 
• The Yajur Veda is set to a tune for chanting during sacrifices.
 
 
 
• Atharva Veda
 
 
• A collection of spells, charms, and magical formulas for healing, protection, and prosperity.
 
• The Atharva Veda is dedicated to prolonging life, healing illnesses, and seeking cures from herbs.
